item.title: EU’s largest electricity distributor chooses ClickShare Hub
item.description: Enedis, which manages 95% of France's electricity distribution network, has become one of the first organisations to deploy Barco's new ClickShare Hub, in a rollout of Microsoft Teams Rooms. item.title: Inside Gran Canaria’s new public transport control room
item.description: A 0.9mm LG microLED display is combined with platforms from Barcelona-based mission-critical environment specialist Gesab to offer features not previously available with room for expansion. item.title: Genelec-powered demo lets visitors experience hearing loss
item.description: Sonova’s Phonak ‘sound demo shelter’ uses Genelec Smart IP loudspeakers and Kemar mannequins to help visitors experience what it is like to be hard of hearing and feel the impact of hearing aids. item.title: Broadcast vendors and AV buyers speak different languages
item.description: An analysis of more than 1,200 texts concludes that broadcast tech vendors exhibiting at ISE 2026 were over-reliant on engineering jargon and didn't understand the nuances of the AV market. item.title: Zoom amps up notes with AI text/images across platforms
item.description: Zoom will now enrich users’ own meeting notes with transcripts from in‑person and online meetings on Zoom, Teams and Meet, plus analysis of visuals such as images, charts and PDFs. The post Zoom amps up notes with AI text/images across platforms appeared first on AV Magazine.

item.title: Epson ‘to double industry sales of 30,000 lumens projectors’
